title: Temple of Mars Ultor
visualBrief: Specific standing Mars Ultor temple remains: occupied raised podium and wide frontal stair with central rough altar remnant; four mapped broken front shafts, three tall mapped fluted Corinthian columns/short surviving entablature and rear pilaster; low fragmentary cella/apse masonry. Include mapped high rear firewall and lower right return with true round-arched Pantani passage. No restored complete roof, pediment, full colonnade, cult statues or copied sculpture/photo atlas. Independent neighboring houses and other Forum ruins remain native.
